title: Karina M NDE 3184
content: I went into insulin shock, convulsions and then nothing (no movement). (This was according to my ex-husband.) I could see a hard to describe 'void' because I could 'see'. I saw no light, no deceased people (known or unknown). I somehow 'received' the understanding (the message? It was not a voice.) That if I died right there and then, my eight month old son would be okay and that my parents would be okay in the long run. I had the certainty that the world (my world) would be okay without me. That my son would grow up healthy and well (he did), and that my parents would survive the pain of my loss. I accepted dying and was willing to let myself go (that's when I felt a weight lift). As I was 'returning' (my ex-husband shoved about four tablespoons of sugar in my mouth), I felt a 'sucking' pull taking me back (I did not 'see' my body from the ceiling or anything that was going on around my body). As I returned (after the pull (strong tug), everything seemed to be moving in incredibly slow motion. I could hear my ex-husband yelling my name in slow motion from a very, very far away place and I began to see his hand moving across my face repeatedly (and very slowly). He later told me he was slapping me to wake me up but I never felt his hand touch my face.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a 'sucking' pull/strong tug taking her back while sugar was put in her mouth.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Insulin shock with convulsions; ex-husband put sugar in her mouth to revive her.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Void experience; nonverbal 'message/understanding' about family being okay; acceptance of dying; 'sucking' pull/strong tug return; slow-motion perception and distant hearing.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or light; primarily void with nonverbal understanding, then pull back with slow-motion sensations.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: No light or beings; received a nonverbal understanding that her infant son and parents would be okay if she died; during return she saw slow-motion hand movement and heard her name from far away but felt no physical contact.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could see a hard to describe 'void' because I could 'see'.” “I somehow 'received' the understanding (the message? It was not a voice.)” “As I was 'returning'... I felt a 'sucking' pull taking me back.” “Everything seemed to be moving in incredibly slow motion.”
